Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_no_of_discards number;
 temp_add_on_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 null,
 null, 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time,
 temp_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null
 then
 show_error('0065');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if temp_contract_id != 'INTERNAL'
 then
 show_error('0400');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 end if;
 if temp_count < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select attrib_code
 into :ctrl_blk_1.proc
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and attrib_group = 'PHER';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0188');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select unit_id
 into temp_unit
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and substr(bag_code,1,1) in ('D','P');
/*Commented by Sobha 001.0215551 - 07/16/02*/
-- and to_number(substr(bag_code,2,1)) <= 4;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1251');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
end;

Item.Name: PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter the product code or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_set_id number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_valid_set VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_valid_prod VARCHAR2(1);
 total_products number(1);
 cursor c1 is 
 select distinct product_code from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 and trunc(coll_date) = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and reject_reason_code is null; 
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_type
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_type 
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and pheresis_flag = 'Y'
 and unit_scheme_type = 'C'
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9752');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 begin
 select nvl(number_products,1)
 into total_products
 from valid_procprod_matrix
 where proc = :ctrl_blk_1.proc
 and product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type 
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')); 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9752');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 BEGIN
 for rec in c1
 loop
 DECLARE
 temp_prod_type varchar2(5);
 temp_pher_flag varchar2(1); 
 BEGIN 
 SELECT product_type, nvl(pheresis_flag,'N') 
 INTO temp_prod_type, temp_pher_flag
 FROM valid_products 
 WHERE product_code = rec.product_code 
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'C';
 IF temp_prod_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and temp_pher_flag = 'Y' 
 THEN
 temp_count := nvl(temp_count,0) + 1;
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 null;
 END;
 end loop; 
 END; 
 IF total_products <= temp_count THEN
 show_error('0155');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 BEGIN 
 select product_code, product_desc, product_type
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :s_product_code_desc, :product_type
 from valid_products vp
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 unit_scheme_type = 'C' and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 and pheresis_flag = 'Y'
 and product_type in (select product_type
 from valid_procprod_matrix m
 where proc = :ctrl_blk_1.proc
 and v_sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')))
 and product_code not in
 (select components.product_code
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 components.product_code =
 valid_products.product_code);
 /* notice that the where clause excludes relabel and pooled
 component clause because they are actual products made
 from that unit */
 :GLOBAL.product_type := :product_type;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_spg number;
 temp_wth number;
begin
 if :s_volume is not null
 then
 select nvl(specific_gravity,1)
 into temp_spg
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and pheresis_flag = 'Y';
 temp_wth := :s_volume * temp_spg;
 IF temp_wth > 999.99 THEN
 show_error('2319','Computed weight too high');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :weight := :s_volume * temp_spg;
 END IF;
 else
 :weight := '';
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select code, code_desc
 into :bag_id, :s_bag_id_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'BAGID' and
 code = :bag_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 then

 begin

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;

 -- message('test');pause;
 synchronize;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
--- message('test');pause;
 synchronize;
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN

 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735','41011') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null; 
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
